question: La Tourangelle brand owner manufacturer
markdown:
La Tourangelle is an independent, family-owned and operated artisan culinary oil maker
. The brand and manufacturing operations are owned and led by founder and CEO
Matthieu Kohlmeyer
, representing the family that originally started the oil mill in France in 1867.
La Tourangelle
